build.scope: No precursor permanent-save fixture. Only initial RNG seeding before actual primary Main launch, ordinary movement/fire/dash, pickup and real pointer reward choices. No stat/gold/upgrade/health/direct-damage injection. Not human playtest or final balance; actual map seed and all offers are recorded separately.

native_scope: Actual production four-view player observed in first chapter; source-bound GPU screenshots, not isolated body alpha or human acceptance. Chain provenance, if enabled, is reported separately.

pointer.scope: Same production Main/Chapter/physics in an isolated engine pointer host, not desktop Window mouse/focus acceptance.

projectile_observations.scope: Read-only production fired/exploded signals. Bounded first 30 ordinary shots and first 120 grenades/explosions; observed explosion geometry is not independent damage attribution or a human aim test.

replay.scope: Actual saved first Boss victory and actual Replay pointer button in same process. Fresh map, fresh run growth, unchanged permanent save, bounded first-encounter normal combat. Not a second victory, six-leg chain or human acceptance.

scope: Real Main pointer UI and ordinary movement/aim/fire; no actor stat writes/direct damage or injected in-run rewards; not human playtest or final six-chapter acceptance
